title: A two-minute breathing reset
summary: A simple slow-breathing exercise you can do at your desk.
body: Slow breathing can help your body settle when you feel tense. Find a comfortable position and press start.
steps: Sit comfortably and relax your shoulders.
Breathe in gently through your nose for about 4 seconds.
Breathe out slowly for about 4 seconds.
Keep going until the timer ends. If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.
